e.title: insurance-ebm（保险 EBM 工作流）
e.summary: Explainable Boosting Machine 的保险精算封装（burning-cost）：相对值/诊断/单调性编辑/GLM 对照
e.body:
insurance-ebm（burning-cost，2026-03 活跃）是微软 interpretML 的 Explainable Boosting Machine（EBM）在保险精算工作流中的封装：产出相对值（relativities）、诊断图、**单调性编辑**（贴合费率监管对单调关系的约束）与 GLM 对照。对 RIAA：精算定价可解释性方法（GAM 风格 EBM 天然支持形状约束）——费率监管重视可解释与单调性，EBM 是 GLM 之外贴合此要求的 ML 选项；与 [[explain-ml-pricing]]、[[shap-relativities]]（相对值可解释）、[[insurance-gam]] 互补成精算可解释工具链；作者 burning-cost 的保险精算 ML 权威系列之一。

e.body_en:
insurance-ebm (burning-cost, active 2026-03) wraps Microsoft interpretML's Explainable Boosting Machine (EBM) for the insurance actuarial workflow: producing relativities, diagnostics, monotonicity editing (fitting regulatory constraints on monotone relationships) and GLM comparisons. For RIAA: an interpretability method for actuarial pricing (the GAM-style EBM natively supports shape constraints) — regulators value explainability and monotonicity, and EBM is the ML option besides GLM that fits these requirements; complements [[explain-ml-pricing]], [[shap-relativities]] (relativity explainability) and [[insurance-gam]] into an actuarial explainability toolchain; part of author burning-cost's authoritative insurance-ML series.
